question: In which of the following Olympics did the Indian football team finish fourth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956 Melbourne**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Olympic Games**:-

 
 
• The Olympic Games are the **world's only truly global, multi-sport, celebratory athletics competition**.
 
• More than **200 countries** participate in more than 400 events across the Summer and Winter Games.
 
• The first Olympics took place in **Athens in the year 1896**.
 
• Upcoming Olympics games are about to take place in **Paris in 2024**.
 
 
 
• **1956 Olympics Melbourne:-**
 
 
• **​**The game took place in the Melbourne city of Australia.
 
• Soviet Unionstood first getting 98 medals, second being United State of America with 74 medals and third place by Australia with 35 medals.
 
• India won a single gold medal in Hockey in 1956 summer olympics.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football Team**:-
 
 
• India played football in the Olympics for the **first time in 1948**.
 
• In **1956**, India stood **fourth** after reaching till semi-finals.
 
• **Since 1960**, India has **not participated **in Football event in Olympics.
